fb_text:
הערב הנר השמיני. הברכה שלה כבר מוכנה?

במקום עוד ברכה ברגע האחרון, ברכה עם הפנים שלה.

במתנה מלומיבוק, בלי כרטיס אשראי.

למתנת החנוכה 👇

sources.title: מתנות אישיות לחנוכה בחינם
sources.supports: one gift: a personal greeting card to share on WhatsApp, or a colouring booklet of five pages to print at home; one clear face photo, no other people; first name, birth month and year so the picture fits the age, no birth day; a second child can be added; a sentence of up to five words, or leave the surprise to the store; no payment and no credit card

sources.title: Key dates
sources.supports: first candle on the evening of Friday 04 / 12 / 2026, last day Saturday 12 / 12 / 2026 (the eighth and last candle is the evening of Friday 11 / 12)

sources.title: Hanukkah 2026 research page
sources.supports: every Hanukkah piece leads to the free gift page; after 05 / 12 only the gift; open: how long the gift takes, until when the page is open

_note: No real greeting card or colouring booklet has been made yet: the pictures here are real children with their books and the store's Hanukkah covers, as stand-ins. Replace the card or booklet pictures with a real gift made on the page before posting.
